**Finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN, critical).**

- **What exists:** Section 13 (p0090–p0093) contains a Garman warranty of IP ownership/non-infringement plus an indemnity for Losses arising from breach of that warranty, with procure/modify/replace remedies. Section 15 (p0105) helpfully carves Sections 13 and 14 out of the liability limitation, so the indemnity is uncapped. No reciprocal Sparkling indemnity appears anywhere in the document.
- **Gap vs. preferred position:** no express duty to **defend**, no coverage of Sparkling's **affiliates**, and no indemnity for Garman's **breach of applicable law**, **unauthorized access to/disclosure of Sparkling data**, or **gross negligence/wilful misconduct** (including resulting personal injury or property damage). Standard claim mechanics (notice, control, cooperation) are also absent for those heads.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** a single new paragraph inserted after p0093 in Section 13 adding Garman's defend-and-indemnify obligation across the four heads with standard notice/control/cooperation, keeping the edit minimal and inside the existing uncapped section.
